decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint builds directly on the firm's core pipeline fittings, welding and testing know-how for water utilities, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and refine it, and it was already promoted to its own page in 2019.

The powder-coated public waste bin draws on the firm's existing coating and steel fabrication capabilities and on its municipal customers, but street furniture is a less familiar market, which makes its fit moderate and its future uncertain.

The waste bin with ashtray uses familiar sheet-metal and powder-coating processes and serves municipalities, but the firm has little market knowledge in this distant segment, so it sits at the margin of being kept.

Outdoor ashtrays are the furthest from the firm's pipeline-component knowledge base, have narrow demand and offer little chance to learn from results, so their resources are better returned to the core infrastructure business.
